name: 5V Relay Module
tagline: Electromechanical switch for safely controlling high-voltage AC/DC appliances
description: A 5V relay module allows microcontrollers (Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi) to switch high-voltage and high-current electrical appliances (up to 250V AC @ 10A / 30V DC @ 10A) through optical isolation (optocoupler), safeguarding low-voltage logic circuits from electrical noise and voltage spikes.

specs.indicator: Status LEDs for Power (Red) and Relay State (Green/Blue)

pinout.name: Normally Open
pinout.desc: Connected to COM only when relay is energized (triggered)

pinout.name: Common
pinout.desc: Main terminal connected to the load power source

pinout.name: Normally Closed
pinout.desc: Connected to COM when relay is idle/de-energized

wiringNote: Always wire the hot (live) AC wire through COM and NO. Never route neutral through the relay.
commonMistakes: Connecting AC mains without proper insulating enclosure
Assuming Active-HIGH when many modules are Active-LOW (LOW = ON)
Powering multiple relays directly from Arduino 5V pin causing brownout resets
